front: What did effective occupation mean at Berlin?
back: A power could claim coastal territory only if it had real control there, not only a paper claim.

front: What is a sphere of influence?
back: An area where one power's right to make treaties and later to rule was recognised by the other powers.

front: When did the Berlin Conference meet and who chaired it?
back: 15 November 1884 to 26 February 1885; Otto von Bismarck.

front: Who was recognised as ruler of the Congo at Berlin?
back: King Leopold II, as the Congo Free State, his personal possession.

front: What were the effects of partition on Africa?
back: Loss of sovereignty, artificial borders, exploitation and resistance.

front: How did the partition affect Europe?
back: It gave empires and pride but kept up rivalry at Fashoda and in Morocco, feeding the tension before 1914.
